IBM's originally reported FY2020 revenue of $73,620 million [ibm_fy2020_10k.txt] included the managed infrastructure services business. On November 3, 2021 IBM completed the separation of that unit into Kyndryl Holdings, and "the historical results of Kyndryl have been presented as discontinued operations in these consolidated financial statements" [ibm_fy2022_notes.txt]. As a result, the FY2022 10-K restates FY2020 revenue on a continuing-operations basis at $55,179 million [ibm_fy2022_income_statement.txt], versus FY2022 revenue of $60,530 million [ibm_fy2022_income_statement.txt].

Two calculations:

| Basis | FY2020 | FY2022 | Growth |
|---|---|---|---|

| As originally reported in each 10-K (not comparable) | $73,620M | $60,530M | −17.8% |

The −17.8% figure is an artifact of the Kyndryl spinoff, not organic decline. The apples-to-apples answer is the continuing-operations comparison: revenue grew $5,351 million, or approximately 9.7%, over the two-year period (~4.7% compound annual growth).

ANSWER: Approximately +9.7% (from $55,179M in FY2020 to $60,530M in FY2022 on a continuing-operations basis, excluding the spun-off Kyndryl business; on an unadjusted as-originally-reported basis the change would be −17.8%, but that comparison is distorted by the November 2021 Kyndryl separation)
